title: 浮屿
prompt:
Render one complete, exceptional high-fidelity desktop GIS application UI for GAIA, edge-to-edge wide 16:10, ideally 1920×1200. No device or marketing mockup. The user works on “滨江公共空间研究”: stations, parks, 800 m straight-line buffers, validation and map export. Display a small “设计预览 · 示意数据” note. Chinese interface text is crisp and readable. Use the reference ONLY as the small unchanged orbital-G app icon beside GAIA. A substantial independent RIGHT COLUMN titled “GAIA 助手” must show conversation, tool evidence, an artifact and a comfortable bottom composer “描述分析或制图要求…”. Include theme/color access. Professional real working screen, no KPI cards, vendor ribbon or oversized welcome hero.
Direction A: 浮屿 / Atlas Air. MAP-FIRST, quiet architectural precision. A seamless, huge 2D city map extends behind a SMALL floating upper-left layer palette, rather than sitting in a boxed column. Finely drawn pale gray streets, broad muted aquamarine river, celadon parks, teal station dots and translucent thin 800 m buffer outlines. A few Chinese map labels, real scale and north indicator. Palette lists “站点 / 公园 / 800 米缓冲”. A short floating upper map action strip contains “添加数据 / 分析 / 布局”. A slim bottom contextual result tray connects “缓冲区 → 点计数 → 核验”, with “查看结果”. RIGHT assistant is a clean opaque white sheet with clear readable hierarchy, request “统计站点 800 米内的公园”, two completed tool steps and “导出 PDF” artifact. Tiny project bar across the top. Silver-white surfaces, deep petrol ink, restrained emerald action color, selective translucent toolbar material, continuous soft corners, excellent alignment and subtle true shadows. The distinctive move is cartography flowing behind a floating toolkit while the conversation remains anchored. More native tactile clarity than nested cards.
notes: Generated map, quantities and task results are illustrative, not executed GIS analysis.
Use the supplied unchanged icon asset in any later implementation.
Selection and application implementation await the user's response.
approval_text: A 做主工作区，C 做出图模式。B 的流程抽屉融入 A。
